name: quietloud-campaign-intelligence
description: Turns internal project knowledge into validated campaign representations — personas, copy, visual direction, and human-gated export.

interface.shortDescription: From internal knowledge to validated campaign assets.
interface.longDescription: Paste a Confluence page, Teams thread, or wiki note. The pipeline extracts signals, reasons about your best audience, builds a persona, picks the right outreach method, generates copy and visual direction, assembles a complete campaign pack, and gates everything behind human confirmation.
